links.effect: Gate released forecasts at 32.7% of visits (strict) and 48.1% (partial-observation extension); suppression driven by incomplete assessment (51.5%) rather than model uncertainty (0.2%).
links.quote: The confidence gate released governed forecasts at 32.7% of visits under strict three-domain requirements, increasing to 48.1% under a validated partial-observation extension.

links.outcome: Predictive interval coverage at 95% level versus linear mixed-effects baselines
links.effect: Coverage 94% to 96% across three endpoints, compared with 64–69% for linear mixed-effects baselines.
links.quote: Predictive interval coverage at the 95% level ranged from 94% to 96% across all three endpoints, compared with 64–69% for linear mixed-effects baselines.
